model_definitions.box: each p in [nominal p,1.2p], all can deviate
model_definitions.budgeted: at most one task deviates by up to p/5; the extremal set is delta_j in {0,1}, sum delta<=1
model_definitions.budgeted_objective: maximize sum of rewards of individually guaranteed early jobs
model_definitions.minimax_constructed_objective: maximize minimum total earned reward over same discrete Gamma=1 scenarios
